text: Role of Information Security in EIM
clean_text: Role of Information Security in EIM
block_text: Role of Information Security in EIM

text: Information security plays a central role in the enterprise information management framework.
clean_text: Information security plays a central role in the enterprise information management framework.
block_text: Information security plays a central role in the enterprise information management framework. As such the Task Force has made a conscious decision not to create a separate section addressing information security. Instead, security will be addressed and its impact will be identified in each of the subsequent sections of this document. In this manner, the System Requirements Specification shall address securing the data artifacts and the processes supporting the creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of information objects.
